products.name: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound)
products.description: Body Protection Compound-157, a synthetic pentadecapeptide studied for tissue repair, angiogenesis and gastrointestinal protection in preclinical models.

products.name: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4)

products.name: CJC-1295 (No DAC)
products.description: Growth hormone releasing hormone analogue without Drug Affinity Complex, studied for pulsatile GH secretion in laboratory research.

products.name: Ipamorelin
products.description: Selective pentapeptide ghrelin receptor agonist studied as a GH secretagogue with minimal effect on cortisol or prolactin.

products.name: GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide)
products.description: Copper-binding tripeptide investigated for collagen synthesis, dermal remodelling and antioxidant activity in skin research.

products.name: Melanotan II
products.description: Cyclic melanocortin receptor agonist studied for melanogenesis and pigment-related research pathways.

products.name: PT-141 (Bremelanotide)
products.description: Melanocortin receptor agonist and Melanotan II metabolite studied in central nervous system signalling research.

products.name: DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide)
products.description: Nonapeptide studied for delta-wave sleep modulation, stress response and neuroendocrine research endpoints.

products.name: Epitalon (Epithalon)
products.description: Synthetic tetrapeptide studied for telomerase activity, pineal regulation and longevity research models.

products.name: LL-37 (Cathelicidin)
products.description: Human cathelicidin-derived antimicrobial peptide studied for innate immune signalling and host defence research.

products.name: Selank
products.description: Tuftsin-derived heptapeptide studied for anxiolytic-like activity and GABAergic modulation in neuroscience research.

products.name: Semax
products.description: ACTH(4-10) analogue heptapeptide studied for BDNF expression and neuroprotective research endpoints.

products.name: AOD 9604 (HGH Fragment)
products.description: Modified fragment of human growth hormone (176-191) studied for lipolytic activity without effects on glucose uptake.

products.name: Hexarelin
products.description: Synthetic hexapeptide GH secretagogue studied for GH release and cardiac tissue research pathways.

products.name: GHRP-2 (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide-2)
products.description: Growth hormone releasing peptide-2 studied for potent GH secretagogue activity in laboratory research.

products.name: GHRP-6 (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide-6)
products.description: Growth hormone releasing peptide-6 studied for GH release and appetite signalling in preclinical research.

products.name: IGF-1 LR3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor-1 Long R3)
products.description: Long-acting analogue of insulin-like growth factor-1 studied for cellular proliferation and anabolic signalling research.

products.name: Thymosin Alpha-1
products.description: 28-amino-acid thymic peptide studied for T-cell maturation and immunomodulatory research endpoints.

products.name: Oxytocin
products.description: Neurohypophysial nonapeptide studied for social bonding, uterine physiology and neuroendocrine research.

products.name: Vasopressin (ADH)
products.description: Antidiuretic hormone studied for osmoregulation, vasoconstriction and neuroendocrine research pathways.

products.name: Gonadorelin (GnRH)
products.description: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone decapeptide studied for LH/FSH secretion in reproductive physiology research.

products.name: KPV (Lysine-Proline-Valine)
products.description: C-terminal alpha-MSH tripeptide studied for anti-inflammatory signalling and mucosal research models.

products.name: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin)
products.description: Glycoprotein hormone studied for LH-receptor activation and reproductive endocrinology research.

products.name: Tesipamorelin
products.description: Growth hormone releasing peptide analogue studied for metabolic and visceral adipose research endpoints.

products.name: Retatrutide
products.description: Triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist studied for metabolic regulation and energy expenditure research.

products.name: Retatrutide 64 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 64mg of retatrutide, a triple GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist. The dose-marked barrel steps in 2, 4 and 8mg increments for reproducible in-vitro dosing series, with excipients disodium phosphate dihydrate, propylene glycol, phenol and sterile water.

products.name: Retatrutide 24 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 24mg of retatrutide for lower-range dose-response work. Triple GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist in a phenol-preserved aqueous vehicle, graduated in 2 and 4mg steps.

products.name: Tirzepatide 30 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 30mg of tirzepatide, a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Graduated in 2.5 and 5mg increments for incretin signalling and metabolic receptor studies.

products.name: Tirzepatide 60 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 60mg of tirzepatide for extended dose-escalation protocols. Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist, graduated in 5, 10 and 15mg steps.

products.name: Semaglutide 8 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 8mg of semaglutide, a long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist. Fine 0.25, 0.5 and 1mg graduations support low-concentration receptor binding assays.

products.name: Semaglutide 15 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 15mg of semaglutide for higher-range GLP-1 pathway work, graduated in 1 and 2mg increments.

products.name: Cagrilintide 20 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 20mg of cagrilintide, a long-acting amylin analogue investigated alongside GLP-1 agonists in satiety signalling models.

products.name: Survodutide 30 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 30mg of survodutide, a dual glucagon and GLP-1 receptor agonist used in comparative metabolic receptor research.

products.name: Mazdutide 24 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 24mg of mazdutide, a GLP-1 and glucagon receptor co-agonist, graduated in 2 and 4mg increments.

products.name: Liraglutide 18 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 18mg of liraglutide, a well-characterised GLP-1 receptor agonist widely used as a reference comparator in incretin studies.

products.name: BPC-157 20 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 20mg of BPC-157 in a phenol-preserved vehicle. Microgram graduations suit repeat-dose tissue-repair and angiogenesis models without repeated reconstitution.

products.name: TB-500 20 Injection Pen
products.spec: Pre-filled pen | 20mg multi-dose | 500 mcg / 1 mg increments
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 20mg of TB-500 (thymosin beta-4 fragment) for actin-binding and cell-migration research, graduated in 500mcg and 1mg steps.

products.name: Ipamorelin + CJC-1295 30 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose blend pen combining ipamorelin with CJC-1295 (no DAC) at a 30mg total peptide load, for combined GHRP and GHRH pathway research in a single graduated device.

products.name: Tesamorelin 20 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 20mg of tesamorelin, a stabilised growth-hormone-releasing factor analogue used in somatotropic axis and lipolysis research.

products.name: AOD-9604 15 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 15mg of AOD-9604, the C-terminal HGH fragment studied for its lipolytic activity without the growth-promoting effects of full-length hGH.

products.name: MOTS-c 30 Injection Pen
products.description: Pre-filled multi-dose research pen containing 30mg of MOTS-c, a mitochondrial-derived peptide investigated for AMPK activation and metabolic homeostasis, graduated in 2.5 and 5mg steps.
